subject: Decision readiness roadmap & next asks
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@novanet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Decision readiness roadmap & next asks

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with Novanet's procurement and security timelines.

What we heard (summary):
- Primary business objective: reduce latency and per-request cost for internal summarization pipeline used by the CX team.
- Decision criteria called out during the call: latency (p95), unit economics (cost per 1M tokens), data residency support, SOC 2 Type II, audit logs / request tracing.
- Stakeholders you flagged: Marco Silva (CFO / economic buyer), Priya Shah (procurement lead), and Anil Mehta (Head of InfoSec) for the security questionnaire.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Procurement wants standard T&Cs and an expected procurement timeline (you mentioned target kickoff mid-December).
2) Security will want our evidence map (SOC2 + logging + data isolation details).
3) Finance asked for a concise ROI estimate for a pilot (3 months) showing projected unit cost savings and headcount/time savings.

What we will deliver by EOD Wednesday:
- One-page decision checklist tailored to Novanet (includes decision criteria mapping). Attachment: RIF-decision-checklist.docx
- A lightweight ROI template to populate with your inputs (we'll attach and can pre-fill if you share current monthly tokens and avg prompt length).
- A suggested internal email for your champion to introduce us to procurement/security (copy below).

Proposed near-term plan:
- Technical kickoff (30 min) to scope integrations and latency targets: propose Mon 12/13 at 10:00 AM PT (we can move if needed).
- Procurement kickoff: target week of 12/15 per your timeline.

Champion intro template (feel free to copy/paste):
Hi Priya / Marco —

Following our discovery with Redwood Inference, we’re evaluating a vendor to improve model latency and reduce per-token costs for our CX summarization pipeline. Redwood has proposed a short pilot and provided a decision checklist and ROI template; can we schedule a 30-min procurement/security intake to review T&Cs and evidence?

Thanks,
Elena

If helpful, I can also prepare a one-slide ROI snapshot for the pilot using placeholder numbers for your review.

Thanks again for the time — I’ll follow up with the checklist and ROI template shortly.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RIF-decision-checklist.docx

Subject: Re: Decision readiness roadmap & next asks

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful and aligns with what I need to drive internally. A couple of clarifications and next items from our side: 

On procurement / timeline:
- Procurement (Priya Shah) will want our standard SOW framework and a summary of any non-standard clauses early. Target: kickoff week of 12/15 and decision by end of year if pilot looks good.

On security / compliance:
- Anil (InfoSec) will ask for: SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency options (EU/US), audit logging retention options, and a short write-up on our ability to segregate logs for regulated workloads.

Decision criteria (in priority order internally):
1) Cost per 1M tokens for our expected profile
2) Latency guarantees / p95 numbers on 1–4k sequence lengths
3) Security evidence & auditability
4) Ease of integration with our ingestion pipeline (Python SDK + REST)

I will introduce Marco (CFO) and Priya (procurement) on this thread — they should be looped in tomorrow. Attaching our procurement contacts CSV for your intake.

Elena

Attachments: Novanet-RFP-contacts.csv

Hi Elena / Marcus — looping in a couple ops/solutions folks so we can move quickly on the asks.

Marcus — thanks for the checklist; below are immediate assets and a recommended talk-track sequence the champion (Elena) can use internally when briefing procurement and finance. I’m attaching a pre-filled ROI template and a security evidence index so procurement/infoSec can find items quickly.

Recommended internal talk tracks (short bullets per stakeholder):
- For Marco (CFO): Focus on unit economics improvements (modeled per 1M tokens), expected pilot delta vs current vendor, payback in months, and optional reserved pricing for Dedicated to cap costs. Keep language quant-focused.
- For Priya (Procurement): Provide our standard SOW and call out any optional clauses (data residency, termination, SLA). Offer a 2-week procurement buffer for legal review in the SOW.
- For Anil (InfoSec): One-page evidence index (attached) with direct links to SOC 2 report, KMS/HSM support, logging architecture, and access controls.

ROI asks we need from Novanet (quick, so we can pre-fill):
1) Current monthly tokens (estimate is fine).
2) Typical prompt + response length (avg tokens).
3) Baseline latency requirement for the CX workflow (p95 target).
4) Pilot sample size / number of users for the 3-month pilot.

Deliverables we will send within 24 hours of receiving the above:
- RIF-ROI-template.xlsx (attached, we can pre-populate if you share numbers)
- security-evidence-index.txt (attached)
- 1-slide ROI snapshot and a procurement-ready SOW summary

Suggested next steps / schedule:
- Marcus / Elena: Technical kickoff 12/13 at 10:00 AM PT (30 min).
- Procurement intake w/ Priya & Anil: 12/15 (30–45 min).

Elena — feel free to use/modify the short talk tracks above. If you want, we can pre-populate the ROI sheet with placeholder numbers and leave clearly labeled cells for Priya/Marco to update.

Marissa
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
